info.description: Guest booking requests against a host listing. Drives the accept/decline flow (issue #6). Status transitions: pending → accepted | declined.

pet_ids.comment: Array of pet IDs selected by the guest at booking time

message.comment: Optional guest message to the host

status.comment: Booking status — set by host via PATCH /api/bookings/:id. Drives the accept/decline flow from issue #6.

total_price.comment: Pre-calculated total cost in AUD at POST time using pricing_overrides from the host record (issue #14). Stored — not recomputed on read.

guest.comment: Authenticated guest user making the booking
